name: routing_v9
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer raising? Pick the single most specific issue.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment, charge, debit or transaction on the account that the customer did not make, does not recognise, or calls unknown or mysterious.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An ATM cash withdrawal shown on the account or in the app that the customer does not acknowledge: they say they did not make it or never got that cash. (Getting less cash than requested at the machine is a different issue.)
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account that the customer did not set up or does not recognise.
criteria.compromised_card: Customer believes their card details have been compromised or someone else is using their card or account.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Customer's card is lost, missing or stolen: reporting or blocking it, or fees and consequences that follow from the loss or theft.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer's phone is lost, stolen or left somewhere and they worry about access to the app.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Customer forgot or wants to reset the app passcode / login code, or cannot get into the app with it.
criteria.pin_blocked: Card PIN is blocked after wrong attempts, or the PIN is rejected.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or setting the card PIN, finding or receiving the PIN.
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund for a purchase, wants to cancel a purchase or order of goods, has not received an item, or asks about refund policy.
criteria.refund_not_showing: An expected refund has not appeared on the account yet.
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction appears twice or more / duplicate charge.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash: The ATM dispensed less cash than requested or the wrong amount.
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled, reversed or returned and the customer asks why.
criteria.cancel_transaction: Customer wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or transaction they sent (for example to the wrong account). Not cancelling a purchase or order of goods from a merchant.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived; tracking a card delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery options or dates, delivery to a country.
criteria.card_linking: Adding or linking a card to the app, or reactivating a card that was found after being reported lost.
criteria.card_not_working: The card stopped working or is not working in general.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment / purchase was declined or rejected.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM declined a cash withdrawal or would not give cash.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept / swallowed the customer's card.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is about to expire or has expired; renewing it.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering or getting a physical card, including fees for a physical card.
criteria.spare_card: Getting an additional or second card, cards for family members, cost of extra cards.
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, or what a virtual card is.
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Getting a disposable / single-use virtual card, or what they are.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on how many disposable cards or how many times a disposable card can be used.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable card does not work or was rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the customer's card will be Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which shops, ATMs or places take it.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used with the card.
criteria.card_limits: Spending or daily limits on the card.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending or has not gone through yet.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal the customer made is still pending, not yet reflected, or the balance does not look right after it.
criteria.transfer_not_received: A transfer the customer sent has not reached the recipient.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Unable to send money to a particular beneficiary / recipient account.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to move or transfer money into the account from elsewhere.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money or salary into the account, including in another currency.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: A bank transfer into the account has not shown up in the balance.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_deposit: A cheque or cash deposit has not shown up in the balance.
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up / add money, methods of topping up.
criteria.top_up_by_card: Topping up using a debit/credit card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer: Topping up with a bank transfer.
criteria.apple_google_pay: Anything about Apple Pay or Google Pay: topping up through them, what they support or accept, adding the card to them, or them not working.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted, returned or cancelled.
criteria.top_up_missing: A top-up seemed to go through but the money is not in the account.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification codes or verifying a card used for top-up.
criteria.exchange_rate: General questions about how exchange rates are set or what rate will apply. Not a complaint that a rate already applied was wrong.
criteria.exchange_charge: Questions about what fees are charged for currency exchange (how much, whether free, discounts).
criteria.exchange_cost_wrong: Complaint that a currency exchange or conversion already made cost more than it should, or that the amount or charges from it are not right.
criteria.exchange_via_app: Exchanging between currencies in the app.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies are supported for holding or exchanging.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card brands or currencies can be used to top up or pay (other than questions about Apple Pay or Google Pay).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_card_payment: Complaint that the exchange rate applied to a purchase, payment or an unspecified past transaction was wrong.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_cash_withdrawal: Complaint that the exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal was wrong.
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee was charged on a card payment, purchase or transaction, or the customer asks why their payments carry fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: A fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal.
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged on a transfer.
criteria.top_up_fee: Fees for topping up (by card, bank transfer or international card).
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An extra fee or surcharge (often a small round amount) appears on the statement or in the app and the customer does not know what it is for. Not a fee the customer knows came with a payment, withdrawal, transfer or top-up, and not an ordinary purchase the customer does not recognise. A small round-amount charge of about one unit of currency that the customer did not expect belongs here, even if it shows as pending or the customer says they bought nothing for that amount.
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements to open an account.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in, or whether someone living outside the UK can sign up or get a card.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address, phone number.
